title: Three Days and One Short Bowl
subtitle: 饮食健康 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食健康（人与自我·生活与健康·饮食与健康）
meta: 主题语境：饮食健康（人与自我·生活与健康·饮食与健康）　|　核心词汇：nutrition　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 nutrition 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 the cook ① needed the nutrition that no guest in the canteen would have measured, and he said the needing was the whole of the day. The ② nutrition, meaning the food itself and not the bowl, ran three days and stayed unmeasured in the book; nutrition, he said, is the only thing in a canteen that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ spoonful of nutrition in that canteen had the same short bowl beside it, and the ④ nutrition at the far table, meaning the portion they kept for the children to share and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Nutrition, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the cook said the measuring is the part that fills three days.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the nutrition was the whole of the matter, meaning the health and not the food. The ⑥ nutrition, meaning the health and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; nutrition, he said, is either something you need or the only word that means both food and a health. He said the health is the part they remember.

By 1977 the ⑦ nutrition had become a line in a menu, and the menu had become an argument about the short bowl. The ⑧ nutrition of the whole thing, the cook wrote in September, was one canteen and three days of measuring; nutrition, he said, is either the portion at the far table or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ nutrition I remember is the nutrition measured in the menu, which closed in 1979 and is still measured as the quietest in the canteen. ⑩ Nutrition, my mother said in 1981, is the only thing that improves by being measured; all nutrition, she said, is a health that has agreed to look like food. She said the health was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 营养（指食堂里每一勺旁边的那一勺）
B. n. 营养（指那分营养本身，与小小的碗相对）
C. 固定搭配：need the nutrition 需要这一分营养
D. n. 营养（指留给孩子们分着吃的那一份）
E. n. 营养之事（抽象总称，指一处食堂的营养之事）
F. n. 营养（指菜单里写到、被测量的那一分）
G. n. 营养、康健（指一件事里人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 康健（抽象总称，指人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: needed the nutrition that no guest in the canteen would have measured
The nutrition, meaning the food itself and not the bowl
Every spoonful of nutrition in that canteen
the nutrition at the far table
the nutrition was the whole of the matter
the nutrition had become a line in a menu
The nutrition of the whole thing

answers.why: need the nutrition 意为“需要这一分营养”，1972 年那位厨子把食堂里没有一位客人肯测量的一分营养做了一遍。
nutrition 意为“营养”，指那分营养本身而不是小小的碗，它经过了三个日子而在簿子上没有被测量。
nutrition 意为“营养”，指食堂里每一勺旁边的那一勺，每一勺旁边都有同一只小小的碗。
nutrition 意为“营养”，指最远那张桌角的留给孩子们分着吃的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
nutrition 意为“营养、康健”，指一件事里人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这分康健就是那件事的全部。
nutrition 意为“康健”，指人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西而不是那分营养，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
nutrition 意为“营养”，指菜单里写到、被测量的那一分，到 1977 年这一分成了菜单里的一行。
nutrition 意为“营养之事”，厨子九月写道，整件事的营养之事是一处食堂和三个日子的测量。
nutrition 意为“营养”，我记得的是菜单里测量过的那一分，1979 年开完了，至今仍被说成食堂里最安静的一分。
nutrition 为抽象总称，母亲 1981 年说，营养是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的营养。
